title: ProductionSignal
description: Per-change history signals for one commit (or PR): survival, rework, review friction, revert linkage, and AI attribution. Attribution design is grounded in real vendor data: Cursor's ai-code-tracking.db scores commits with per-source line counts (tab/composer/human) and an aiPercentage — and in the observed database only 11 of 72 commits actually had those counts populated. 'partial' and 'unknown' are therefore normal states, not error states. Attribution is NEVER inferred from code content or style; only from tracking-db evidence, session-trace linkage, or explicit self-report. 0.2.0 (ADR-0006): adds required provenance (repo path, HEAD at measurement, content hash) matching the extractor's traceability contract; records are local-only artifacts, like extracted sessions. 0.3.0 (ADR-0015): generated paths are excluded from line counting — change_ref.lines_added/deleted are WORK counts, the required `generated` block carries the excluded delta and the pattern-list version, and a commit touching only generated files reports survival/rework status `excluded_generated` (its own absence word, DESIGN.md).

signals_version.description: Version of the harness/signals code that computed this record.

provenance.description: How this record was computed — the signal analog of the session record's provenance (session schema 0.3.0+). Survival/rework numbers depend on repo state, so head_sha pins WHAT was measured against; content_hash is the idempotency key (hash of the computed signal payload — unchanged repo state for this commit's horizons yields an unchanged hash).

repo_path.description: Local repo root as read. Local-only artifact — never enters version control; repo_ref is the reportable identifier.

head_sha.description: HEAD of the analyzed history at measurement time.

repo_ref.description: Opaque repo identifier (hashed for private repos; plain for public OSS).

status.description: known = line-level evidence covers the whole change (e.g. a fully scored Cursor commit). partial = some evidence exists but doesn't cover the change (e.g. session linked to the PR but no line-level split, or a Cursor commit with only some sources scored). unknown = no evidence; the default. Never inferred from what the code looks like.

evidence_source.description: vendor_tracking_db = e.g. Cursor scored_commits / ai_code_hashes. session_trace_link = a trace_event ties an agent session to this change. none iff status=unknown.

ai_lines.description: Line-level counts only when the evidence actually provides them (Cursor: tabLinesAdded + composerLinesAdded); otherwise null — never estimated.

ai_fraction.description: Null unless ai_lines/human_lines are populated. Kept as evidence, not identity: reported at team level and above only.

vendor_score_version.description: Vendor scoring version when evidence_source=vendor_tracking_db (Cursor exposes v1/v2 aiPercentage; record which).

survival.description: Line survival at fixed horizons. A change younger than the horizon is 'not_yet_measurable' — absence of the measurement is encoded, not conflated with 0% or 100% survival.

rework.description: Was this change's code modified again shortly after landing?

review.description: Review friction. Null for changes with no PR (direct pushes, solo repos) — a structural gap in local/solo data flagged for enterprise validation, not zero friction.

revert_detection.description: How the revert linkage was found — only explicit evidence; no content-similarity guessing.

generated.description: ADR-0015: what the generated-file filter removed from this commit's line counts. Unfiltered totals are change_ref numbers plus these.
